REAL WIRING. STATED ASSUMPTIONS.

What makes the response?

This app runs a spiking model over 166,700 annotated neurons and 25,582,938 directed connections from the official MaleCNS v1.0 release. There are no synthetic connections and no language model choosing dates.

1. A fly profile becomes a stimulus
Each virtual fly has preset visual and chemical-relay stimulation rates. We directly stimulate real LC10a, vAB3-labelled and mAL populations using seeded Poisson spikes. This is an experimental interface to sensory relays, not a complete simulation of eyes, smell, taste or a living partner. The photograph and bio do not enter the model.
2. Activity follows the mapped connections
Every connection retains its published synapse count. Leaky integrate-and-fire dynamics use parameters adapted from Shiu et al. (2024): resting potential −52 mV, threshold −45 mV, membrane time constant 20 ms, synaptic decay 5 ms, delay 1.8 ms, refractory time 2.2 ms and 0.275 mV per synapse. We use a 0.2 ms simulation step. This transfers a modelling approach, not its validation, to MaleCNS.
3. A small courtship panel describes the encounter
pC1 is used as a courtship-associated state readout; pMP2 is a male-specific descending pulse-song pathway; pCd-linked DNpe034 cells are shown as a persistent social-state readout. pIP10 remains visible as an associated courtship-song descending signal, but it is not used to label the encounter because it varied too strongly across the controlled runs. “Interested” requires pC1 and pMP2 elevation; moderate pC1 without pMP2 is “Investigating”; low pC1 is “Not interested.” These interface labels are experimental and do not claim natural mate preference.
What the model cannot claim
It does not resurrect the original fly or demonstrate natural mate preference. Neuron dynamics, sensory encoding and interface thresholds still require courtship-specific validation. GABA, glutamate and histamine are modelled as inhibitory; other known transmitters as excitatory. Unknown or unclear transmitters contribute no outgoing current. This simplifies receptor effects, neuromodulation, non-spiking cells and electrical synapses.
What you can verify
Every downloaded data chunk is checked against a SHA-256 digest. The complete identity table and provenance are downloadable. Every encounter starts from rest with the same random seed, so differences come from the candidate inputs, not invented memories. The map uses measured soma positions; neurons without soma coordinates are still simulated.
